notes: 5 photos on rotating digital menu screens. Photos 1 & 5 are the same food board at two price points (used photo 5, the more recent/updated one, which also adds Garlic Chicken Wings). Photos 2 & 4 are drink-only boards (Thai tea, coffee, soda, water) and were excluded per the drink-list rule, except Shaved Ice which is a food dessert item and was kept. Photo 3 is a desserts board; its two dipping sauces (Jel Bong/Jel Som) were excluded as condiments, and one price (Jel Som) was garbled anyway.
